status: PROPOSED: nothing here is frozen, nothing has an outcome
rules: one primary specification per family; no parameter grid, no 'try variants and keep the best'
every constant is the a-priori value in core/intelligence (frozen by the spec hash once the owner approves)
outcomes are opened only on VALIDATION' once, after the spec hash is recorded and the owner approves
Test-H, Holdout, Confirm-C stay locked; DEV' is used for signals and label behaviour only
a family that cannot reach the required sample is reported INCONCLUSIVE, never promoted

k_budget.note: K is counted per family; adding a variant raises K and the bootstrap bar with it

hypotheses.statement: After a decisive close beyond a tight 12-bar M15 box, price continues in the breakout direction farther than the box height more often than a matched control set of bars with the same ATR percentile and session.
hypotheses.falsified_if: the continuation share does not exceed the matched control's by the preregistered margin on VALIDATION', or net R after the cost model is not above 0
hypotheses.known_issue: median risk 2.8 ATR: a 1.5 net R:R needs a 4 ATR target, which may starve the family (geometry, not edge)

hypotheses.statement: A sweep bar followed within 6 bars by a structure event in the opposite direction precedes a move in that direction more often than a matched control.
hypotheses.known_issue: 48% of BOS/CHoCH events lose the broken level within 3 bars on DEV' (label noise); the confirmation may be as noisy as the sweep

hypotheses.statement: In a RANGE-labelled market, a wick rejection at the boundary of the last 20 bars is followed by a move back into the range more often than a matched control.
hypotheses.known_issue: the regime label flips every ~11 bars on average (median run 5): a RANGE label is not persistent enough to carry a thesis without a persistence filter, and adding one is a new variant (K+1)

controls.matched_control: bars with the same timeframe, ATR percentile bucket, session and distance-to-boundary bucket but no event; drawn with a fixed seed
controls.cost_model: executable-quote spread per bar, as in cand_replay (core/costs); unknown cost is never zero
